# E0133: a schema's references form a cycle

References within a schema may not form a cycle: a cycle makes the schema's
paths unbounded, and no check can describe it. Each cycle is reported once, at
the reference that closes it.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				#A: {b?: #B}
				#B: {a?: #A}
				root: #A
			}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0133]: schema 0.0 has a reference cycle: #B -> #A -> #B
 --> lineage.cue:6:10
  |
6 |                 #A: {b?: #B}
  |                      ^
  |
  = note: a schema's references may not form a cycle: no check can describe a schema whose paths are unbounded

error[E0133]: schema 0.0 has a reference cycle: #A -> #B -> #A
 --> lineage.cue:7:10
  |
7 |                 #B: {a?: #A}
  |                      ^
  |
  = note: a schema's references may not form a cycle: no check can describe a schema whose paths are unbounded
```
